scope: Proposed planning workflows; not a deployed implementation or live integration assertion

items.title: Service area screening
items.manual_boundary: Confirm actual capacity and exceptional locations.
items.integration_gate: Approve the list and routing rules; retain uncertainty rather than rejecting negotiable areas.

items.title: Centralized enquiry collection
items.manual_boundary: Log unsupported phone/voicemail sources and resolve uncertain identities.
items.integration_gate: Test actual mailbox notifications, expired cursors, folder scope, attachments and source replay.

items.title: Enquiry ownership and prioritization
items.manual_boundary: Confirm urgency, sensitive routing and candidate invoice/booking identity.
items.integration_gate: Add approved assignment/escalation rules and notification outcomes; current classification is a suggestion.

items.title: Missing information detection
items.manual_boundary: Resolve ambiguous dates, verify authenticity and provide missing answers.
items.integration_gate: Approve required fields and test representative forms. F applies to checking, not obtaining truthful answers.

items.title: Participant onboarding and profile updates
items.manual_boundary: Approve identity, consent, field values and separate service/accounting readiness.
items.integration_gate: Validate native intake feature fit, actual forms, mapped fields and account writes; preserve prospects until activation is approved.

items.title: Worker onboarding coordination
items.manual_boundary: HR verifies qualifications, employment decisions and payroll readiness.
items.integration_gate: Test role/invitation behaviour and readiness checks. A recorded onboarding status does not itself establish sign-in permissions.

items.title: Client stages and agreed service details
items.manual_boundary: Approve activation, service hours, funding implications and effective dates.
items.integration_gate: Extend the mapping whitelist for explicit stage transitions; define which native record owns agreed hours rather than creating a second editable agreement.

items.title: Correspondence preparation
items.manual_boundary: Approve sensitive wording and send through the agreed channel.
items.integration_gate: Implement reusable templates and checks. Do not depend on an unverified ShiftCare SMS/chat send API.

items.title: Communication tracking and history
items.manual_boundary: Resolve unsupported channels and verify actual acknowledgement when required.
items.integration_gate: Agree channel coverage and add permitted Sent Items/failure evidence. A Graph 202 response is not delivery proof; universal cross-channel read receipts are not promised.

items.title: Booking preparation and availability checks
items.manual_boundary: Confirm suitability, worker willingness, participant agreement and native acceptance.
items.integration_gate: Add a whitelisted one-off create adapter and explicit native IDs/defaults if API creation is included. Availability patterns need date expansion; free time is not willingness.

items.title: Booking change scope and verification
items.manual_boundary: Approve occurrence/series scope and resolve group or locked bookings.
items.integration_gate: Keep initial writes to accepted occurrence scope. Series operations are published but not implemented in the existing adapter.

items.title: Travel checking and stale value detection
items.manual_boundary: Verify ambiguous addresses and approve actual claims or scheduling decisions.
items.integration_gate: Move dependency fingerprints/checks to shared server records. F covers estimates and stale-value checks, not mileage entitlement.

items.title: Shift instruction maintenance
items.manual_boundary: Approve wording, effective date and affected occurrences.
items.integration_gate: Add a description-only adapter, version/hash checks and read-back. Validate series behaviour and locked/cancelled records before bulk changes.

items.title: Participant confirmation monitoring
items.manual_boundary: Resolve sender/occurrence ambiguity and approve any resulting service mutation.
items.integration_gate: Test actual notification formats, mailbox routing, quoted replies and occurrence matching; add event reads if needed.

items.title: Complete cancellation handling
items.manual_boundary: Approve cause, notice, actual travel and financial treatment; review locked or unsupported changes.
items.integration_gate: Add verified cleanup before cancellation where required. Cancelled shifts restrict later edits. Model cleanup-success/cancel-failure and block closure until required handoffs finish.

items.title: Absence and replacement cover coordination
items.manual_boundary: Choose suitable cover and confirm worker acceptance and participant preference.
items.integration_gate: Add shared cover-case dependencies and affected-service tracking. Keep offer and acceptance native until their adapters are accepted.

items.title: Factual absence histories
items.manual_boundary: Management resolves disputed facts and all employment interpretation.
items.integration_gate: Defer dedicated HR history until core absence coordination is accepted; define restricted access and corrections.

items.title: Document matching and filing
items.manual_boundary: Confirm person, signature/version, category and permitted visibility.
items.integration_gate: Validate actual document types, field/date formats and download hosts. Do not claim the adapter supports every staff file or image.

items.title: Document completeness and attachment checks
items.manual_boundary: Assess signature, authenticity and documents held outside the visible sources.
items.integration_gate: Add requirement matrices and complete-scope results. F covers presence/metadata checks, not proof that a valid agreement exists or is absent everywhere.

items.title: Document date and expiry correction
items.manual_boundary: Interpret document meaning and approve non-expiring classifications.
items.integration_gate: Validate date/null/no-expiration response semantics. General staff-file expiry correction is not implemented in the current adapter.

items.title: Renewal and coordinator follow up
items.manual_boundary: Verify received documents, funding/date meaning and completion.
items.integration_gate: Reuse native reminder sending, repair metadata first, avoid duplicate alerts and implement missed-run recovery and escalation.

items.title: Invoice preparation checks
items.manual_boundary: Bookkeeper approves category, charge, tax and unusual treatment, then uses native export.
items.integration_gate: Add cursor-aware pre-invoice reads and agreed rules/cutoffs. Use native pricing rather than calculating care billing rates in the application.

items.title: Special billing instructions and prepayments
items.manual_boundary: Bookkeeper applies balances and approves accounting treatment.
items.integration_gate: Defer live balance integration until authorized Xero access and ID reconciliation are implemented. Do not create another ledger.

items.title: Billing recipient verification
items.manual_boundary: Staff verify authority and effective payer changes before updating billing.
items.integration_gate: Defer dedicated cross-system recipient automation; keep checks in existing onboarding/billing review until account mappings are verified.

items.title: Returned invoice resolution
items.manual_boundary: Bookkeeper determines credit, correction or reissue and checks the result.
items.integration_gate: Defer a dedicated correction/reissue automation; reuse #3/#22 cases and native accounting actions first.

items.title: Payment follow up
items.manual_boundary: Bookkeeper approves disputes, escalation and any collection action.
items.integration_gate: Defer custom collection status until ledger IDs, tokens and reconciliation are accepted; do not treat a ShiftCare balance as verified Xero payment.

items.title: Pay period and employee checks
items.manual_boundary: Payroll confirms final-pay eligibility and the meaning of prior values.
items.integration_gate: Defer payroll-side automation until the actual vendor/field mappings are known. Inactive ShiftCare access does not establish zero pay.

items.title: Timesheet hours and mileage reconciliation
items.manual_boundary: Payroll approves payable values and resolves discrepancies before native release.
items.integration_gate: First deliver source checks and reviewed handoff. Add two-sided comparison only against the real export/API; do not claim automated payroll reconciliation without it.

items.title: Payroll adjustment tracking
items.manual_boundary: Payroll calculates and approves leave, back pay and travel treatment in the established payroll process.
items.integration_gate: Keep calculations and native entry manual initially; support evidence through #28 rather than building an award/payroll engine.

items.title: Payroll completion handoffs
items.manual_boundary: Authorized payroll staff finalize the run, release payment and deliver payslips in the payroll platform.
items.integration_gate: Retain finalization and money movement in the established platform; a duplicate release workflow adds little benefit and substantial risk.

items.title: Visit record and care exceptions
items.manual_boundary: Supervisors investigate quality, care and employment concerns.
items.integration_gate: Validate complete periods, staff-specific evidence and restricted access; task-specific completion comparisons need accepted source fields.

items.title: Feedback complaint and safety follow through
items.manual_boundary: Managers handle safety, complaint outcomes and personnel decisions; urgent procedures remain active.
items.integration_gate: Add restricted case fields, owners, follow-up schedule and explicit urgent escalation; avoid automatic clinical triage.

items.title: Task completion handovers and escalation
items.manual_boundary: People perform tasks and management supplies delegated authority and actual coverage.
items.integration_gate: Add parent-case dependencies, external notification outcomes and catch-up. Current native jobs can complete before their separate communication follow-up.

items.title: Operational outcome reporting
items.manual_boundary: Management interprets staffing, cost and demand implications.
items.integration_gate: Keep baseline pilot measures in core instrumentation; defer a dedicated reporting workflow until daily work is stable. No forecast model is proposed.

items.title: Arrival visibility if the remaining gap is confirmed
items.manual_boundary: Approve access/consent and validate actual devices and withdrawal behaviour.
items.integration_gate: Defer optional arrival work pending native-feature fit and device/privacy trials; continuous background tracking is not established.
